card.title: IPhone XR front camera not working

source.title: IPhone XR front camera not working

claims.statement: Replacing the whole XR front camera assembly loses Face ID; you can cut out just the front camera and keep the IR cam and dot projector. Flash an update after replacing or it won't work.
An open filter on the front camera connector line can be replaced with a same-size backlight filter—never a jumper.

procedure: Try a new front camera and update iOS.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
